description.zh-CN: 基于 WebSocket 实时断连事件记录节点真实在线率历史与 30 天可用性。插件可独立采集数据与提供 API；强烈推荐搭配 Komari Emerald Insights（翡翠洞察）主题，以在前端直观展示真正的 30 天在线率与可用性分析条带。

description.en: Exact WebSocket connection event ledger and 30-day availability history for Komari. Operates standalone for data collection and APIs; strongly recommended to pair with Komari Emerald Insights theme to display true 30-day availability in the UI.

name.zh-CN:
⚠️ 前置提示与推荐搭配：需配合前端主题展示在线率
• 独立运行说明：本插件专注于后端事件账本，基于 WebSocket 实时连接事件精确计算 30 天可用性并提供 REST API。插件可单独安装运行，无需前置 VPS 采集端。
• 强烈推荐搭配主题：Komari 原生界面不包含在线率图表与可用性历史面板，强烈推荐安装配套主题 Komari Emerald Insights（翡翠洞察）！配合该主题即可在「资源概览」与节点卡片中渲染出真正的 30 天在线率与可用性条带。
• 相关链接：Emerald Insights 翡翠洞察主题 ｜ Emerald 生态总览 ｜ 插件主页

name.en:
⚠️ Notice & Recommendation: Frontend Theme Required to Display Availability
• Standalone Operation: This plugin operates as a backend ledger, recording real connection events via WebSocket and serving REST APIs. It runs standalone with no extra VPS agent needed.
• Strongly Recommended Theme: Komari default UI does not include 30-day availability charts. It is strongly recommended to install the companion theme Komari Emerald Insights to render actual 30-day uptime and availability history in the UI.
• Links: Emerald Insights Theme | Emerald Suite Overview | Plugin Repo
